newsitem.title: USA: Intl Home Foods buys Bumble Bee Seafoods.
newsitem.headline: Intl Home Foods buys Bumble Bee Seafoods.

text.p: International Home Foods Inc said Tuesday it acquired Bumble Bee Seafoods Inc, a unit of Thailand's Unicord Co Ltd, for $163 million in cash and the assumption of certain liabilities.
Bumble Bee filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy on May 2, 1997, to restructure its debt and facilitate the sale of the company, a Bumble Bee spokeswoman said.
The agreement to sell the company to International Home, a unit of investment firm Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc, came on the same day as the bankruptcy filing, the spokeswoman said.
International Home Foods said in a statement on Tuesday that it owns Chef Boyardee canned pastas, Pam cooking spray, Gulden's mustard, Polaner Fruit spreads and other shelf-stable food products.
